blind.description: A stylized low wooden display shelf or curio cabinet stocked with mystical artifacts. The top surface holds a glowing pearlescent orb on a wooden/brass tripod stand, a horned animal skull, and a purple amethyst crystal cluster on a rocky base. The middle shelf contains a green crystal cluster, a carved tribal face mask, and an ornate openwork brass/gold sphere. The lower open shelf holds a thick red/burgundy tome with golden fittings and a small reinforced metal/wood chest. The bottom section consists of a cabinet with two panel doors and round knobs. The wooden frame has stylized hand-painted textures with solid, continuous surfaces, standing upright on integrated corner feet.
blind.from_above: A curved rectangular wooden top shelf featuring a pale spherical orb on a stand on the left, a horned animal skull pointing forward in the center, and a faceted purple crystal cluster on the right.
blind.height_vs_figure: About two-thirds the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 3.8 to 4 ft tall), and roughly 3.5 ft wide.
